name: Cognigy
tagline: Enterprise conversational & agentic AI for voice and chat customer service.
description: Cognigy is a customer-service AI platform that builds voice and chat agents on a low-code flow builder, with an Agent Copilot that assists human agents in real time. It's LLM-agnostic, integrates with contact-center stacks, and runs as managed cloud or self-hosted. Enterprises like Adidas, Nestlé and Toyota use it to automate front- and back-office customer interactions.
insight: Acquired by contact-center vendor NiCE in September 2025 for about $955M; still offered as a standalone platform.

modelSupport.notes: LLM-agnostic — connect your own model or provider.

edge: Enterprise-grade contact-center depth with LLM-agnostic model choice — picked by brands like Adidas and Toyota over narrower point solutions.
